This appeal under Section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988, is filed being aggrieved of award dated 28.06.2019, passed by learned Second Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Maihar, District Satna (M.P.), in M.V.C.No.149/2017.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is submitted that accident took place on 16.08.2017.

Injured Brijbhan Saket (Suryawanshi),
sustained fracture of right femur bone and also a fracture of right leg below knee.

He was working as Brajbhan Saket (Suryawanshi) vs Vinod Kushwaha on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/134904851/
1
a Mason (Mistri) and was earning a sum of Rs.500/- per day.

Tribunal has awarded meager compensation of Rs.96,229/- in his favour out of which Rs.31,421/- is towards the medical bills,
Rs.10,000/- under the head of attendant, nutritious diet, transport etc.
Rs.34,800/- under the loss of income for a period of six months, Rs.10,000/- under the head of mental agony and physical pain and Rs.10,000/- under the head of future medical expenses.
3. On the date of the accident, minimum wages even for an unskilled labourer were to the tune of Rs.7125/- per month.

Thus, when wages for six months as have been awarded by the Tribunal are taken into consideration, then it comes out to Rs.42,750/-(Rupees Forty Two Thousand Seven Hundred and Fifty) in place of Rs.34,800/- (Rupees Thirty Four Thousand and Eight Hundred)
awarded by the Tribunal.
Thus, there will be enhancement to the tune of Rs.7,900/- (Rupees Seven Thousand and Nine Hundred) under the head of loss of earning.
Tribunal has awarded only a sum of Rs.10,000/- under the head of pain and suffering, which is enhanced to Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand).

Thus, there will be addition of Rs.15,000/- (Rupees Fifteen Thousand)
under that head.

4. Tribunal has awarded only a sum of Rs.10,000/- under the head of transport, nutritious diet and attendant which are enhanced to Rs.16,000/- (Rupees Sixteen Thousand) under the head of nutritious diet @ Rs.4,000/- per month for a period of four months.

Another Rs.16,000/- (Rupees Sixteen Thousand) under the head of attendant for a period of four months @ Rs.4,000/- per months and a sum of Rs.5,000/- (Rupees Five Thousand) under the head of transport.

Thus, total amount payable will be Rs.37,000/- (Rupees Thirty Seven Thousand) in place of Rs.10,000/-
(Rupees Ten Thousand).
Thus, there will be addition to Rs.27,000/- (Rupees Twenty Seven Thousand) under the head of nutritious diet, transport and attendant.

5. Tribunal has awarded only a sum of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand) under the head of future treatment, looking to the nature of injuries and two fractures which is enhanced to Rs.20,000/-
(Rupees Twenty Thousand).

Thus, there will be addition of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand)
under the head of future treatment and physio therapy etc.

6. Thus, there will be total enhancement to the tune of Rs.59,950/- (Rupees Fifty Nine Thousand,
Nine Hundred and Fifty) in favour of the appellant, which will earn interest @ 6% per annum from the date of filing of the Claim Petition till the date of actual payment.
7. In above terms, appeal is disposed of.
8. Record of the Claims Tribunal be sent back.
(VIVEK AGARWAL) JUDGE A.Praj.
